properties.description: Estimates of 2025, total number of people per grid-cell. The dataset is available to download in Geotiff format at a resolution of 3 arc (approximately 100m at the equator). The projection is Geographic Coordinate System, WGS84. The units are number of people per pixel. The mapping approach is Random Forest-based dasymetric redistribution.
properties.coordinate_reference_system:name: EPSG:4326
properties.coordinate_reference_system:units: Geographic (uses latitude and longitude for coordinates)
properties.coordinate_reference_system:accuracy: Based on World Geodetic System 1984 ensemble (EPSG:6326), which has a limited accuracy of at best 2 meters.
